newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA DROP SLATER, MCINTYRE FOR ONE-DAY MATCH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA DROP SLATER, MCINTYRE FOR ONE-DAY MATCH.

text.p: Australia have dropped Michael Slater and Peter McIntyre from the team who lost last week's one-off test to India for their Titan Cup opener against South Africa on Saturday.
All-rounder Stuart Law and paceman Jason Gillespie have been named in the side for the 50 overs triangular series game, replacing opener Slater and leg-spinner McIntyre.
Captain Mark Taylor shrugged off Australia's seven-wicket test humiliation and said he was looking forward to a high-scoring match in Indore.
"Our guys are getting sharper," Taylor said on Friday. "We never look back."
"It is a very good wicket and the outfield is quick. We are obviously looking at 250 plus runs. It would be a good wicket for 100 overs."
In the opening Cup match on Thursday, South Africa crushed India by 47 runs.
Australian: Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Ricky Ponting, Michael Bevan, Stuart Law, Steve Waugh, Ian Healy, Glenn McGrath, Paul Reiffel, Jason Gillespie, Brad Hogg.
